text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.

WHEAT SALES - Mexico overnight bought 18,000 tonnes U.S. hard red winter wheat slated for October delivery, U.S. exporters said. Half of the shipment was for $190 a tonne and the other half was for $198.00 a tonne via rail.

CORN SALE - South Korea's state-backed National Livestock Cooperative Federation said on Tuesday it bought 53,000 tonnes of Argentine feed corn at $162.90 per tonne, C&F. Shipment arrival was set for June 20 to Inchon.

VEGOIL SALE - India's State Trading Corporation purchased a total of 12,000 tonnes of palm olein at its tender on Tuesday, European vegetable oil traders said. The STC bought one parcel for first half October shipment at $585 a tonne cost and freight and a further parcel at $581 a tonne c and f for second half November shipment, traders said.

SOYBEAN MEAL TENDER - The CCC said it was seeking 5,000 tonnes of U.S. soybean meal under the export donation program for Russia. Shipment was slated for September 30-October 15 and bids are due on September 17.
CORN TENDER - Jordan is to seek 50,000 tonnes of U.S. Number 3 yellow corn in one lot for shipment in the first half of November. Offers must be received by September 25.
- Taiwan's FGEP corn-buying group will tender on Wednesday for a shipment of 54,000 tonnes of U.S.No.2 corn slated for November delivery, traders said.
RICE TENDER - Ivory Coast will seek 29,000 tonnes of PL-480 long grain brown rice for Oct 15-Nov 15 and/or Nov 15-Dec 15 shipment. Bids are due by Sept 11.

CORN AND SOYBEAN TENDER - State-owned Taiwan Sugar Corp will tender for a 10,000-tonne position of No.2 or better U.S. yellow corn on Friday. Taiwan Sugar would tender soon for a combined shipment of 18,000 tonnes U.S. corn and 12,000 tonnes U.S. soybeans for late October to early November delivery.

WHEAT TENDER - Algeria has launched a tender for the import of 100,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Canadian durum wheat for shipment between the second half of October and the first half of December, European grain traders said. Results are expected by the end of the week, they said.
WHEAT TENDERS - Philippine firms plan to buy 20,000 tonnes of U.S. wheat, traders said.
- The CCC will tender on Sept 12 for 8,000 tonnes of U.S. SRW wheat for donation to Jamaica.
- The CCC said it is seeking 25,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat under the export donation program for Bosnia. Shipment is slated for October 5-31 and bids are due on September 17.
- The CCC on Sept 10 seeks 19,860 tonnes of soft white wheat of which 15,340 is for donation to Ethiopia and 4,520 for Pakistan for Sept 25-Oct 20 shipment.

WHEAT TENDERS - The CCC seeks 23,500 tonnes of U.S. wheat for donation to Honduras. The deal includes 5,000 tonnes northern spring/dark northern spring wheat and 3,000 tonnes soft red winter wheat set for November 1-25 shipment. It also includes 9,500 NS/DNS wheat and 6,000 tonnes SRW wheat slated for December 10-30 shipment. Offers are due on September 11.

COTTONSEED AND RAPESEED MEAL TENDER - South Korean feed mill companies passed on tenders for 8,000 tonnes of cottonseed meal and 12,500 tonnes of rapeseed meal due to high prices, traders said. Traders said the lowest bid for cottonseed meal was $157.83 per tonne by Toepfer with Chinese origin for shipment in December. There were no bids for rapeseed meal. Cottonseed meal was set for the delivery on December 10, while rapeseed meal on March 20.
MARKET TALK - Indian exporters have signed contracts for nearly 275,000 tonnes of soymeal exports for November-December shipments and expect prices to further firm up, traders said.
USDA said an authorization to buy $8 million worth of U.S. rice under Public Law 480, Title I was issued to Jordan.
